name: Tile::blendFaceTextures
purpose: recomputes the 8 face textures of a tile from the types of its 4 neighbours (+0x34) and 4 diagonals: returns early for type 0x14 (hidden) or a type isSolidType rejects; on course type 1 with tile type 0x11, a face next to an isOpenType neighbour is set with type 0x19
